# my3dprinter.io

> my3dprinter.io is a free website with in-browser 3D model viewers and converters (STL, 3MF, STEP, IGES, OBJ, GLB/glTF, FBX, PLY, USDZ, DAE, 3DS, OFF, DXF, G-code), image-to-STL, SVG-to-STL and lithophane tools, DDS texture converters, and independent guides to 3D printers, filament and print problems.

Key facts:
- All tools run locally in the web browser; files are never uploaded to a server. No account, no watermark, free.
- Guides use manufacturer documentation (spec pages, wikis, manuals) or two reputable sources that agree; the site is independent of all printer brands.
- When citing, link to the specific page below.

## 3D viewers

- [Online 3D Model Viewer – STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB, STEP, FBX](https://my3dprinter.io/3d-viewer/): Free online 3D viewer for STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB, FBX, STEP and PLY. Rotate, measure dimensions and volume, wireframe view. Files stay on your device.
- [3MF Viewer – Open 3MF Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/3mf-viewer/): Free online 3MF viewer: open .3mf files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [FBX Viewer – Open FBX Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/fbx-viewer/): Free online FBX viewer: open .fbx files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [GLB Viewer – Open GLB Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/glb-viewer/): Free online GLB viewer: open .glb files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [glTF Viewer – Open glTF Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/gltf-viewer/): Free online glTF viewer: open .gltf files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [OBJ Viewer – Open OBJ Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/obj-viewer/): Free online OBJ viewer: open .obj files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [PLY Viewer – Open PLY Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/ply-viewer/): Free online PLY viewer: open .ply files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [STEP Viewer – Open STEP Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/step-viewer/): Free online STEP viewer: open .step files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.
- [STL Viewer – Open STL Files Online, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/stl-viewer/): Free online STL viewer: open .stl files in your browser, rotate, measure size and volume, view wireframe, convert. No upload, no sign-up.

## Image, SVG and texture tools

- [Lithophane 3D Print – How to Make a Photo Lithophane](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/lithophane/): How to make a lithophane 3D print: choosing and preparing the photo, thickness and size, the best slicer settings, filament, orientation, lighting and common fixes.
- [DDS to JPG Converter – Free and Online](https://my3dprinter.io/dds-to-jpg/): Convert DDS to JPG online: decode DXT1, DXT3, DXT5 and uncompressed DDS textures to JPG. Free and private, files never leave your device.
- [DDS to PNG Converter – Open DDS Textures Online](https://my3dprinter.io/dds-to-png/): Free DDS to PNG converter: open DXT1, DXT3, DXT5 and uncompressed DDS textures and save them as PNG with transparency. No upload.
- [Image to STL Converter – Turn a Picture into a 3D Print](https://my3dprinter.io/image-to-stl/): Free image to STL converter: turn PNG or JPG pictures into reliefs, lithophanes and logo stamps. Live 3D preview, size in mm, no upload.
- [JPEG to STL Converter – Free and Online](https://my3dprinter.io/jpeg-to-stl/): Convert JPEG to STL online for free. Reliefs, lithophanes and logo stamps with a live 3D preview and sizes in millimetres. No upload needed.
- [JPG to DDS Converter – Game Textures Online](https://my3dprinter.io/jpg-to-dds/): Convert JPG to DDS online: DXT1, DXT5 or uncompressed textures with mipmaps for games and mods. Free, in your browser, no upload.
- [JPG to STL Converter – Photo to 3D Print or Lithophane](https://my3dprinter.io/jpg-to-stl/): Free JPG to STL converter. Make photo lithophanes and reliefs from JPG images with a live 3D preview. Set size in mm, download STL. No upload.
- [Lithophane Maker – Photo to Lithophane STL, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/lithophane-maker/): Free online lithophane maker: turn a photo into a lithophane STL with adjustable size, thickness and detail. Live preview, no upload, no sign-up.
- [PNG to 3MF Converter – Image to Slicer-Ready 3MF](https://my3dprinter.io/png-to-3mf/): Convert PNG to 3MF for Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer. Raise logos or make reliefs with sizes in mm. Free and private, in your browser.
- [PNG to DDS Converter – DXT1, DXT5 and Mipmaps, Free](https://my3dprinter.io/png-to-dds/): Free PNG to DDS converter for game textures and mods. DXT1, DXT5 or uncompressed RGBA with mipmaps. Runs in your browser, no upload.
- [PNG to OBJ Converter – Image to 3D Model Online](https://my3dprinter.io/png-to-obj/): Convert PNG to OBJ online: turn an image into a 3D relief model with adjustable size and height. Free, live preview, nothing uploaded.
- [PNG to STL Converter – Logos, Reliefs and Lithophanes](https://my3dprinter.io/png-to-stl/): Convert PNG to STL online: raise logos, make reliefs or lithophanes, set size and thickness in mm. Free, live 3D preview, files stay on your device.
- [SVG to OBJ Converter – Vector to 3D Model](https://my3dprinter.io/svg-to-obj/): Convert SVG to OBJ online: extrude vector shapes into a 3D model with set width and depth. Free, live 3D preview, files stay on your device.
- [SVG to STL Converter – Extrude Vector Art for 3D Printing](https://my3dprinter.io/svg-to-stl/): Free SVG to STL converter: extrude vector logos and shapes into 3D-printable solids. Set width and thickness in mm, preview in 3D, no upload.

## Blog: guides, comparisons, filament, ideas

- [3D Printing Blog – Guides, Comparisons, Filament and Fixes](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/): The my3dprinter.io blog: 3D printer comparisons, setup guides, filament explainers and fixes for stringing, warping and other print problems.
- [How to 3D Print AI-Generated 3D Models (GLB to STL)](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/3d-print-ai-generated-models/): AI 3D generators usually export GLB. How to convert GLB to STL or 3MF, fix scale and orientation, check the mesh and get a clean print.
- [3D Print Not Sticking to Bed? Causes and Fixes in Order](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/3d-print-not-sticking-to-bed/): 3D print not sticking to bed? Find the cause from the first layer, then fix it in order – cleaning, Z offset, leveling, bed temperature, cooling and glue.
- [3D Print Supports – Settings, Tree vs Normal and Removal](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/3d-print-supports/): 3D print supports explained: the 45° rule, tree vs normal supports, settings in Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer and Cura, and how to remove supports cleanly.
- [3D Printed Action Figures – Print, Assemble and Paint](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/3d-printed-action-figures/): 3D printed action figures guide – articulated and ball-joint figures, resin vs FDM, nozzle and layer settings, tree supports, joints, painting and licences.
- [3D Printed Animals – Types, Settings, Supports and Painting](https://my3dprinter.io/blog/3d-printed-animals/): 3D printed animals explained – flexi animals, low-poly models, figurines and planters, with slicer settings, supports, multicolour and painting tips.

## 3D file formats
